title: Grant-anchored cooldown reset: wait is scheduled only when the grant is bound via start_effect
description: olc5.12.1 finding. Ring of Djinni Summoning spends its cooldown in use_item, but the 24-hour wait starts only if a later start_effect binds particular-djinni and that effect ends. A DM who narrates the summon without binding leaves the ring depleted forever. F5 grant-anchored cooldown reset therefore stays unlanded. Fix: couple the spend and the grant (for example, refuse the spend without a binding or schedule on a DM ruling that the grant ended). Decide before landing the F5 hook.
close_reason: Resolved on eshyra-olc5.12.2 (commit b205724d): an anchored summon's spend is coupled to its bind (start_effect refused unless the economy is spent and unscheduled, one live bind per spend), use_item returns hint.bindGrant, and an unbound spend is recoverable by a late bind. F5 grant-anchored cooldown reset is landed.
